summary: Google DeepMind researchers compare humans, frontier LLMs, and Bayesian agents in multi-player bargaining games, finding LLMs and humans achieve comparable surplus but via different negotiation strategies.

practices.reason: The study shows performance-parity benchmarks can mask procedural differences in agent behavior, a caution relevant to evaluating agentic LLM deployments.
practices.quote: These findings highlight that performance parity—a common benchmark in agent evaluation—can mask substantive procedural differences in how LLMs behave in complex multi-agent interactions.
